disorder-name.detail: Amyloid-positive individuals across the Alzheimer's Disease Spectrum (ADS), including preclinical AD (CDR=0), very mild dementia (CDR=0.5), and mild/severe dementia (CDR≥1). NM was applied to both discovery (ADNI-ADS) and replication (ADRC-ADS) cohorts.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "a target disease group of amyloid positive individuals across the ADS. A total of... 231 amyloid-positive individuals across the ADS were included in the target disease group (ADNI-ADS) from ADNI... the disease group (ADRC-ADS) consisted of 129 amyloid-positive individuals on the ADS"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Discovery dataset: ADNI-ADS (N=231 amyloid-positive ADS individuals from ADNI). Replication dataset: ADRC-ADS (N=129 amyloid-positive ADS individuals from Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC at Washington University in St. Louis).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We constructed a discovery dataset consisting of individuals from ADNI and a replication dataset consisting of individuals from the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC dataset at Washington University in St. Louis."

age.detail: ADNI-ADS: mean=73.6, SD=6.9, N=231; ADRC-ADS: mean=71.5, SD=8.3, N=129. Combined weighted mean=(231×73.6+129×71.5)/360=72.85 years. Pooled SD=sqrt((230×6.9²+128×8.3²)/358)=7.43. Min/max not reported.
